tbesh_subentries.definition_html: (Qal) to bore, dig, dig for water

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to trench; by implication, to throw forth;  to wall up, whether literal (to build a wall) or figurative (to estop)
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; also denominative from H7023 (קִיר)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: break down, cast out, destroy, dig.
